newsitem.title: USA: AirTouch customer growth remains strong.
newsitem.headline: AirTouch customer growth remains strong.

text.p: AirTouch Communications said Wednesday added a record 518,000 proportionate cellular and paging customers during its third quarter, reaching over 7.2 million total proportionate worldwide customers.
For the third consecutive quarter AirTouch added more international cellular customers than domestic cellular customers.
The company said in a statement it added 151,00 new cellular customers domestically.

Spurred by strong demand in Japan, Germany, Italy and Spain the company added a record 242,000 proportionate international cellular customers, reaching 1,408,000 customers, up 122 percent over the year-ago period.
AirTouch added 123,000 paging units in service in the U.S. for a total of 2,735,000.

The company said it expects to add at least 1.2 million cellular customers worldwide during 1996. AirTouch said operating cash flow is likely to approach $1 billion, adding that in light of third quarter performance those goals could possibly be exceeded.
The company's results include the effect of its August acquisition of Cellular Communications Inc.

AirTouch now serves 3,072,000 proportionate cellular customers, up 60 percent over the year-ago period, including more than 360,000 proportionate customers added through the acquisition of Cellular Communications.
